widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **Image to Video** task (`MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo` node), which covers both:

- **t2va** (text-to-video), when no images are connected
- **fl2va** (first/last-frame image-to-video), when `first_frame` and/or `last_frame` are connected

**Key inputs**

- **first_frame / last_frame**: optional keyframes; the model generates the motion between them
- **prompt**: describe the shots, motion, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps


## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, anime style, a medium shot continuously frames two young women against a solid flat pink background shown in <Picture 1>, preserving each character's facial features, eye shape and color, hairstyles, body proportions, clothing structure (white short-sleeve school shirts, red ribbon ties, grey plaid skirts, black knee-high socks), the solid flat pink background, and the original two-character composition throughout. There are no environmental elements, furniture, windows, walls, or scenery — only the solid pink color fills the background for the entire duration. On the left, the girl with long black hair and crimson eyes (Character A) has her left arm draped over the shoulder of the girl on the right. On the right, the girl with short pink hair and violet eyes (Character B) stands with her hands near her front, her cheeks carrying a faint flush. The camera holds a static shot with no cuts for the entire duration. [0.0s–1.5s] Character B closes her mouth gently from its slightly open position. Character A blinks once, a grin forming at the corner of her lips. Both characters breathe softly, their shoulders rising and falling. [1.5s–4.0s] Character A leans in toward Character B's ear, a teasing whisper: <d>[Japanese] ねぇねぇ、ちょっと聞いてよ。</d> Character B's eyes shift sideways, her shoulders tense, and she swallows. She responds in a guarded voice: <d>[Japanese] え？なに急に</d> Character A straightens up, her grin widening. Character B blinks twice, still looking at Character A. [4.0s–6.5s] Character A continues, savoring the moment: <d>[Japanese] あいつね……ほんと素敵なの。</d> She turns her face toward the camera, one eye closing in a playful wink. Character B's mouth opens sharply, her brows drawing together, her hand clenching at her side. She snaps back: <d>[Japanese] ……は？何言ってんのよ。</d> Character A tilts her head, her grin growing even wider. Character B's chest rises with a sharp breath. [6.5s–8.5s] Character A faces the camera, bright and insistent: <d>[Japanese] ね？でしょ？でしょ？</d> Character B's flush deepens, her eyes narrow, her grip tightens on her sleeve. She bursts out: <d>[Japanese] ……もう、うるさい！べたべたしないで！</d> Character A flinches in mock surprise, then laughs silently. [8.5s–10.0s] Character A maintains her arm around Character B's shoulder, a satisfied smile, blinking slowly. Character B turns her face away, pouting, a strand of pink hair drifting across her face, her chest rising and falling with a deep breath. Both breathe softly, shoulders shifting gently.

overall_soundscape: quiet stillness, soft rustle of fabric from subtle body movement

non_diegetic_music: A light, bouncy marimba melody at a cheerful moderate tempo, playful and gossipy in rhythm. The final seconds slow into a gentle sustained note as the scene settles.
